message.reasoning_content: need to identify crimes based on facts: illegal mining of rare earth without permit, causing resource damage valued at ~4.96 million yuan. Chinese criminal law provisions: Illegal mining (非法采矿) is punishable under Article 338 of Criminal Law (非法采矿罪). Also possibly "破坏资源罪"? Actually Article 338: "非法采矿、采石、采砂或者非法开采其他矿产资源，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So crime is "非法采矿罪". Also "非法占有" not relevant. Could also be "非法采矿造成资源破坏价值" maybe "破坏自然资源罪"? There's also Article 338 covers illegal mining causing resource damage. So singular crime: "非法采矿罪". Also maybe "非法采矿、破坏矿产资源罪"? The name is "非法采矿罪". So answer: [罪名]非法采矿罪<eoa>
